vulnerability.explanation: JBIGEncode ignores the caller-provided input size ((void)size) and passes a pointer to the input buffer into jbg_enc_init/jbg_enc_out. jbg_enc_out will read (imagewidth+7)/8 * imagelength bytes from the buffer based on directory dimensions without any check that 'size' is large enough, leading to a read past the end of 'buffer' if the caller supplies fewer bytes than required.
